 2020
Common Order:

-
These criminal petitions under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, are filed seeking quash of the charge sheets in C.C.No.702 of 2018 on the file of the learned Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District and C.C.No.976 of 2020 on the file of the learned Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Gudur and also the F.I.Rs. registered in Crime No.203 of 2019 of Atchampet Police Station, Guntur District and Crime No.161 of 2019 of Naidupet Police Station, SPSR Nellore District.

entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Naidupet Police Station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that these are covered matters and this Court has earlier quashed the F.I.Rs and charge sheets registered for the similar offences based on identical facts.
Therefore, they would submit that the petitioners, who are similarly placed, are also entitled for quash of the F.I.Rs and charge sheets registered against them.
4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would fairly concede that these are covered matters in view of the earlier orders of this Court and thereby prayed to pass appropriate orders accordingly.

5. As can be seen from the copy of the common order produced by the petitioners in Criminal Petition No.1432 of 2020 and batch, it is clear that this Court has quashed the F.I.Rs registered in various police stations for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328, 353, 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, under Sections 56, 57(1), 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and under Sections 24 (1) r/w 27 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003.
